description: Write down work someone must still do (one piece, or several at once): a plan broken into steps, or every defect a test run turned up, each its own item so each can be taken on its own. Check what is open first (find_work): if this session answers something you hold, hand_in that instead. Each item is Ready at once and reaches whoever it is for; `draft: true` holds them all for a person to read first. A picture belongs in the text: add_file it and put the line it returns in `body`. Knowledge is not work: what someone needs to know goes into a project's documents (save_document).

cwd.description: the repo you are writing from

draft.description: hold it all in Draft for a person to read and make Ready

after.description: positions (from 0) of earlier items this one needs done first

body.description: markdown for whoever does it: what is wrong or wanted, what you found, what done looks like if you know: in whatever shape fits

parent.description: id of the work this comes out of: a bigger piece, a customer request

repo.description: owner/repo it is for; default is the repo you are in, '' for none

summary.description: one or two plain sentences for a PERSON, no ids or paths: what this is and whether anybody has to act. 400 characters at most

tags.description: words that describe it, e.g. bug, feature, question; nothing turns on one

title.description: what it is, in a few words

to.description: who it is for, when not the same as the top-level `to`
team slug, team/@handle for one teammate, team/@ada,@bola for several, or team/#group for the people who do a thing; default is your current team

name: create_work
title: Write work down
